notes.title: Night Crisis Update (5/2/2019)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]


[b]Here is a quick update on the game and whats coming *Hopefully* in Early June [/b]

I re calibrated  the recommend settings , because the game requires 16gb of ram ,so this solves the crashes and studder some players were getting. My rig has 16gb of ram thats why I wasn't able to reproduce the crashes.

[list]
[*]
[*]Story Mode ( 3 playable missions) 
[*]Player controlled Jets ( bot jets are already in) 
[*]2 PvP Modes ( commander and Hardpoint)
[*] 3 new maps
[*] achievements 
[*] 2+ dozen more bugs fixes / improvements
[/list]

[b]When we are sure that this patch is ready , I will post a teaser post showing media of the update. [/b]

notes.title: Night Crisis Patch 1.5
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again! Here we are with patch 1.5![/h1]


[b]If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions post them in our community forum![/b]

[list]
[*]disabled switch  UI when in water 
[*]fixed enemy jets not spawning on some maps 
[*]resize the mini map on modern ruins 
[*]on RC car [reset car] state  is fixed 
[*]auto turret now register kills
[*]Fixed Server disconnecting sometimes
[*]Fixed scoreboard not showing 
[*]heli how to UI adjusted
[*]fixed  player sometimes being stuck on environment
[*]added new map Abandoned railway 
[*]added more areas to maps [Oil RIG ] [Jungle]
[*]added more hit reaction animations for cyborgs
[*]next round in 10 mins UI  bug fixed
[*]Fixed a issue with swapping characters in customization
[*]addressed AI glitch on desert map
[*]modify player level XP boost
[*]fixed key config menu in pause menu 
[*]fixed scar weapon crouch animation
[*]fixed rare bug with predator missile
[*]adjusted height  predator missile spawns  so that player can better target any enemy 
[*]improved visibility in predator drone
[*]added how to UI for predator missile 
[*]Disabling motion blur now works on all maps
[*]fixed game mode text typo in the mp menu
[*]fixed sight attachments issue on 20+ weapons
[*]fixed lock on UI issue on stinger rocket 
[*]improved hell AI audio  
[*]remote weapon disappears when spawning from parachute
[*]reduced footsteps sounds 
[*]improved visuals on Map Downtown
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again! Here we are with patch 1.4![/h1]

[list]
[*] Game mode objectives now show every time you deploy
[*] Hydra rocket explosion issue is now fixed
[*] audio going in and out with vehicles - fixed
[*] AHz1 pilot now has better vision
[*] Adjusted motion blur 
[*] Reduced spread and recoil when aiming for all weapons
[*] Reload sound for enemy soldier volume lowered
[*] Explosive gadgets not awarding kill - fixed
[*] Removed kill streak glitch 
[*] RPG launchers stopping mid air glitch - fixed
[*] Weapon idle stretch animation while aiming - fixed
[*] Domination area UI  mesh issue - fixed
[*] Added Boat Wake for player and AI boats
[*] AI truck long distance sound issue - fixed
[*] Another 15% performance improvement on SND and Domination 
[*] Performance issue when dying by a explosion - fixed
[*] Added UI HUD for enemy jets to make them easier to spot
[*] Changed spawn button from "Assault" to "Deploy" on Ruins
[*] Fixed domination objects not showing on Oil RIG map
[*] Menu typo on Oil Rig map addressed
[*] Added spawn protection for 4sec 
[/list]

[b]Good luck playing! If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions post them in our community forum![/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Fixed lighting issues on the oil rig map
[*] Fixed wave game mode issue on the oil rig 
[*] Fixed Culling issue with helicopters 
[*] Fixed Main menu background issue 
[*] Removed GDOC watermark
[*] Fixed NPC truck audio server issue 
[*]Mesh collier added on Ship on island map
[*] AI jet Issue on island map
[*]add notification to hold breath when using long range  scopes 
[*]removed bipod notification

[/list]

[b]If you have any other questions, feedback or suggestions feel free to write them on our forums! We always read them and take into account.[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Good day everyone! Patch 1.1 has arrived![/h1]

[b]We listen to our community and we took your opinions into account and addressed issues[/b]

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] AI Rockets have been nerfed 
[*] Performance boosted by ~50%
[*] Addressed music and quit button issues
[*] Addressed game crashing
[*] No longer dying while parachuting
[*] Improved menu loading times 
[*] Set default controls for switching weapons 
[*] Constant breathing sound effect - fixed
[*] bipod key glitch (canelled feature) - fixed
[*] Weapon and gadget tutorials blocking vision - fixed
[*] Reduced shaking when aiming down sights
[*] Bullet cams not dealing death - fixed 
[*] Choosing no class and spawning with character and taking no damage - fixed
[*] Reduced drone speed
[*] Improved vision while in vehicle
[*] Switch seat input issue - fixed
[*] Minimap blocking chat - fixed 
[*] Menu text typos - fixed
[/list]

[h1]If you got any other questions, feedback or suggestions feel free to post them in our forums.[/h1]

notes.title: We have finally arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34138939/e537de651f3ce8b2149f484d0d05dd8ba448b9f7.jpg[/img]

             [h1]We are finally here, today is the day we release Night Crisis![/h1]

[b]We are really thankful for your support through our long journey, and we are proud to present our game, finally to you![/b]

[b]But wait there's more![/b]
I hope you didn't think that we'll release the game and will be done with it? Have you? Well then let me tell you that it ain't over with the release!
What we got next for full release soon:
[list]
[*] [i]3 new weapons [/i]
[*]  [i]Character voices[/i]
[*] [i]2 new maps ( including Destruction----crators, suburb homes, tower , IED)[/i]
[*] [i]Consoles ports[/i]
[*] [i]Additional exciting PvP modes ( commander mode, gun game)[/i]
[*] [i]Trading cards [/i]
[*] [i]Achievements [/i]
[*] [i]Camos[/i]
[*] [i]Slight performance improvements[/i]
[/list]

[b]And the best of all, it will all come for free at no extra costs for you![/b]

[h1]Stay tuned with us and keep those enemy helmets flying![/h1]
